content_sections.heading: Description
content_sections.text: Black stainless steel pineapple pattern (黑色菠萝纹盲道钉) tactile studs are surface‑mounted indicators featuring a distinctive pineapple/conical texture with a black finish – specifically engineered to provide essential underfoot cues for pedestrians who are blind or visually impaired while achieving the required visual contrast against light‑colored flooring surfaces. The black finish serves a critical accessibility function: luminance contrast . Accessibility standards such as AS1428.4 require tactile indicators to achieve a minimum luminance contrast of 45% with the surrounding floor finish . The black PVD or painted coating provides this necessary contrast against light concrete, tiles, or marble surfaces, making the studs highly visible to people with low vision while still delivering tactile guidance underfoot
